{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Chicken|Chicken]]

Even more tangy than using buttermilk.

== Ingredients ==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] smoked [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|granulated garlic]]
* 1 tsp ground [[Cookbook:Ginger|ginger]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] thighs, legs, and boneless breasts
* Freshly-squeezed [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]
* [[Cookbook:Cornmeal|Cornmeal]] as needed for dredging
* 16 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] vegetable [[Cookbook:Shortening|shortening]]

== Procedure ==
# Combine paprika, salt, pepper, granulated garlic, ginger, and cayenne.
# Moisten chicken with lemon juice and coat with seasoning mixture.
# [[Cookbook:Dredging|Dredge]] chicken in cornmeal and let rest 2–3 minutes only.
# Melt shortening in a large cast iron [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]]; heat to 350°F, watching carefully to prevent burning.
# Place legs and breasts around the edges, then place thighs in the center.
# [[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] for 12 minutes, then flip to the other side and fry another 12 minutes.
# Drain on a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|cooling]] or oven rack. Please don't use paper towels, which will make your chicken greasy.
# Sprinkle with black pepper; serve.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* The reason for putting the chicken in different spots is because there is usually a hot spot in the center of the pan.
* The chicken will stay rocket-hot for a good 20 minutes after frying, so do not put the chicken into an oven—it'll just make it soggy.
